question: In a code language, PERMANENT is written as RFPNBMTOE and AUTHORITY is written as TVARPHYUI. How will ESTABLISH be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

PERMANENT is written as RFPNBMTOE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8815ea9d0ec09460b692c88564dbccf50eb76e921ce9c7e93fecc5a83613eab9.png] 

And,

AUTHORITY is written as TVARPHYUI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df5ec9f772bb0edd13419b825bb04252a02568d76dbb49bfb8b1947d7233ac02.png] 

Similarly,

ESTABLISH is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d827e489ec5a7b4271b31b276e302c722b82df0e67d11440f2580f55ac60f8c7.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
